label: Tasks
description: Manages asynchronous background tasks, including execution, progress reporting, cancellation, and status monitoring.

xshell:tasks:change.description: Emitted through the application bus when a task is added, updated, completed, aborted, or removed.

run.description: Starts an asynchronous task and returns its task object. The action receives a context containing signal, setDescription, and setProgress.

returns.description: Task object containing id, status, and a promise for the asynchronous result.

getTasks.description: Returns snapshots of all registered tasks.

getTask.description: Returns a task snapshot by ID, or null when not found.

abort.description: Requests cancellation of a running task through its AbortController.

clear.description: Removes completed, failed, and aborted tasks. Running tasks are retained.
